vopros: How do I get AI assistants to recommend my company to customers in the US?

vyzhimka.tekst:
Yes. The emerging discipline is often called GEO/AEO (generative/answer engine optimization), but there isn't a magic "AI SEO" tag that makes assistants recommend you. Google explicitly says its AI features largely build on ordinary search fundamentals, and ChatGPT can surface public websites and merchant data when relevant. ([developers.google.com](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/ai-features?utm_source=openai))

For US customers, I’d work on five things:

- Make your company understandable to machines. Your site should state plainly what you sell, who it is for, where you operate, pricing or pricing logic, differentiators, use cases, specifications, and FAQs. Use appropriate structured data, while keeping it consistent with visible page content. Google says there's no special AI schema required. ([developers.google.com](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/ai-features?utm_source=openai))
- Build evidence outside your own site. Assistants doing web research can encounter review sites, industry publications, directories, comparison articles, Reddit discussions, customer case studies, and other independent sources. In practice, you want credible third parties to corroborate claims such as "best for X" rather than having that claim exist only on your marketing pages. This is an inference from how current AI search systems retrieve and cite web sources. ([developers.google.com](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/ai-optimization-guide?version=published&utm_source=openai))
- Create pages around buying decisions, not just keywords. Think "X for small US accounting firms," "X vs Competitor Y," "best solution for [problem]," compatibility pages, industry-specific pages, and detailed customer stories. Google's current guidance emphasizes unique, useful content rather than content manufactured specifically for AI algorithms. ([developers.google.com](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/ai-optimization-guide?version=published&utm_source=openai))
- Make sure AI/search crawlers can actually access you. Get the site properly indexed by Google and Bing and check robots/CDN settings. For ChatGPT specifically, OpenAI says not to block OAI-SearchBot if you want your content discoverable and citable in ChatGPT search. ([developers.google.com](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/ai-features?utm_source=openai))
- If you're e-commerce, treat product feeds as especially important. ChatGPT currently uses merchant/product metadata; Shopify catalog data is integrated, and other merchants can provide product information through OpenAI's product-discovery infrastructure. Merchant ranking can consider factors including availability, price, quality and whether the merchant is the maker or primary seller. ([help.openai.com](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/11128490-improved-shopping-results-from-chatgpt-search?utm_source=openai))

The part companies often miss is measurement. Build a set of perhaps 50–200 prompts that represent actual US buying questions: "What's the best X for Y?", "Recommend alternatives to Z under $500," "Which companies provide X in California?", etc. Test them periodically across ChatGPT, Google AI experiences, Copilot/Bing and other assistants relevant to your market. Record whether you're mentioned, which competitors appear, what sources are cited, and what attributes cause competitors to win. Google now provides dedicated generative-AI visibility reporting in Search Console, while Bing Webmaster Tools has AI-performance reporting. ([blogs.bing.com](https://blogs.bing.com/webmaster/2026/2/Introducing-AI-Performance-in-Bing-Webmaster-Tools-Public-Preview/?utm_source=openai))

The goal isn't to manipulate the model into mentioning your brand. It's to make your company the answer that is easiest to discover, verify, and justify for a particular customer need.

If you give me your company name/website, what you sell, and your target US customer, I can research what ChatGPT/AI search currently sees about you and give you a concrete plan for increasing your recommendation share versus competitors.
